items.text: What is the name of Andhra Pradesh's long-term development vision launched by CM Chandrababu Naidu?
Andhra Pradesh's Swarna Andhra @2047 vision aims to transform the state into a ₹308 lakh crore economy. What is this approximately in USD?
The Swarna Andhra @2047 vision targets what per capita income for AP citizens by 2047 (currently ~₹2.66 lakh)?
Which of the following is NOT one of the core pillars of the Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision?
options: Valley of Innovation and Speed of Business

items.text: The Swarna Andhra @2047 KPI Portal monitors performance at which administrative levels?
options: Mandal, district, constituency and state levels
Mandal and district levels only — state is monitored separately

items.text: The KPI framework under Swarna Andhra @2047 is primarily aligned with which global framework?
What annual growth rate does the Swarna Andhra @2047 vision document target for the AP economy?
options: 8% — in line with India's national average

items.text: As a district officer, what is your PRIMARY role in the Swarna Andhra KPI system?
options: Entering mandal-level data and forwarding it to the state without review
Entering, verifying and approving district/mandal level KPI achievement data
Setting district KPI targets independently based on local priorities
Reviewing KPI data only when a state-level audit is initiated

items.text: What is the correct relationship between GVA and GDP?
options: GDP = GVA + Net Taxes on Products (Taxes minus Subsidies)
GDP = GVA adjusted for inflation using the Price Deflator
GDP = GVA minus Depreciation of fixed assets

items.text: Which approach measures GDP by summing value added at each stage of production across all sectors?
options: Expenditure Approach — adds up all spending in the economy
Income Approach — sums wages, profits and rents
Production (Output) Approach — sums GVA across all sectors
Base Year Approach — fixes prices at a reference year

items.text: The 'bottom-up approach' to estimating District Domestic Product means:
options: National GDP is calculated first and then disaggregated to districts using population or area shares
Economic data is collected and aggregated upward from district and mandal level
Only the lowest-income sectors in a district are measured to set a baseline
District-level GVA is estimated using state-level averages applied uniformly

items.text: Which of the following economic activities belongs to the TERTIARY sector?
options: Food processing in a registered factory
Electricity generation from a thermal power plant
